routed.why: Measured once, at M3's close: does shipping the unproven pages and the wrappers harm what is proven? The guided arm's files, every page under docs/ that the index links to, read as they ship, unstripped, and the wrappers' local plugin enabled.

routed-no-plugin.why: M3 slice Z's diagnosis (Q81): the routed arm with the wrappers' plugin left out, to tell whether the wrappers or the pages drive the routed arm's loss of the claim-marked-verified label. The same files as routed, read as they ship, unstripped.
